title: Gugak-VocalSet: A Multi-Genre Studio-Quality Dataset of Korean Traditional Singing with Sigimsae Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.15350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Gugak-VocalSet, the first publicly available audio dataset for Korean traditional singing with dense annotations of sigimsae, a structured pitch contour system of vocal expressions. Gugak-VocalSet contains 24.5 hours of unaccompanied solo vocal recordings across 305 tracks of representative repertoire curated by the National Gugak Center, performed by 20 professional singers in a controlled studio environment with fixed key and tempo. In addition to genre, lyrics, and mood/timbre tags, the dataset provides a unified sigimsae ontology and approximately 68,000 segments (71,700 instances including multi-label) of audio-grounded sigimsae annotations; the ontology adopts a functional-position-based hierarchy designed for consistent application across genres, and 14 expert annotators specializing in Korean traditional music performed segment-level labeling accordingly. translated_title: Gugak-VocalSet：一个带有Sigimsae（声乐装饰音技法）标注的多流派录音室级韩国传统歌唱数据集
translated_abstract: 我们推出了Gugak-VocalSet，这是首个公开可用的韩国传统歌唱音频数据集，其中包含对sigimsae（一种结构化的声乐表达音高轮廓体系）的密集标注。Gugak-VocalSet包含24.5小时的无伴奏独唱录音，涵盖由国立国乐院精选的305首代表性曲目，由20位专业歌手在受控录音室环境中以固定调性和固定节奏演唱。除流派、歌词以及情绪/音色标签外，该数据集还提供了统一的sigimsae本体体系以及约68,000个片段（包含多标签共计71,700个实例）的基于音频的sigimsae标注；该本体采用基于功能-位置的层次结构设计，以确保跨流派的一致应用，并由14位专攻韩国传统音乐的专家标注者据此进行片段级标注。在sigimsae分类与事件检测任务上的基线实验（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了首个公开的韩国传统歌唱数据集Gugak-VocalSet，包含24.5小时录音室级多流派独唱录音、统一的sigimsae（传统声乐装饰技法）本体体系以及约6.8万条专家标注片段，并提供了分类与事件检测的基线实验。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Gugak-VocalSet, the first publicly available Korean traditional singing dataset featuring 24.5 hours of studio-quality multi-genre recordings, a unified sigimsae ontology, and approximately 68,000 expert-annotated segments, along with baseline experiments on classification and event detection.
